text:
ryan: starting preflight for 01:00 UTC change window. Targets: api v2.9.0, runtime 3.5.1, router 4.2.0, console 2.0.1. Window 01:00-03:00 UTC. Canary plan: 4% x12m -> 20% x25m -> full. Wave id rw-17491. @maya runtime, @lee router please ack blockers now.

lee: ack. Router 4.2.0 adds a routing header rewrite for tenant sharding. If console doesn't accept the new header name we should keep ROUTER_REWRITE=false for canary. Also note a slight increase in socket connect time ~8-12ms on canary images in staging.

maya: ack. Runtime 3.5.1 flips the kv-prefetch behavior. For the canary i'd like to use runtime:3.5.1-prefetch-off to keep prefetch=false. Will publish that tag in a few mins.

ryan: ok plan: runtime variant will be prefetch-off, router will deploy canary with ROUTER_REWRITE=false. SRE/ops watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx and token generation time. Abort if p99>820ms or 5xx>0.25%. deploybot configured to run ramps and emit signals.

deploybot: queued wave rw-17491. Canary config: {"canary_pct":4,"canary_stage_min":12,"abort_conditions":["p99>820ms","5xx>0.25%"]} Deploy when all acks present.

lee: pushing router canary with rewrite disabled. Command:
```
kubectl set env deployment/router-canary ROUTER_REWRITE=false -n prod-canary
```

maya: runtime tag published: runtime:3.5.1-prefetch-off. Please target that.

deploybot: canary start at 01:03 UTC. Rolling api v2.9.0 -> ok, runtime:3.5.1-prefetch-off -> ok, router 4.2.0 (REWRITE=false) -> rolling to 4%.

deploybot: 4% reached at 01:16 UTC. Short checks: 198/200 health, watching metrics.

ryan: seeing token generation p99 spike to ~900ms reported by ops-bot on two runtime pods. Maya any logs?

maya: pulling runtime logs. Snippet:
```
[01:18:02] WARN kv_prefetch_triggered keys=120 batch=3 duration=430ms pod=runtime-5
[01:18:02] INFO eviction_scan loop took=95ms
```
Prefetch appears to be firing despite tag. Investigating variant routing; maybe deploybot targeted wrong pool.

ryan: hold ramp and pause router increase. Deploybot, pause further ramps.

deploybot: ramp paused by signal at 01:19 UTC. No further increases. Canary remains at 4%.

maya: confirmed mis-target: pool selector used "runtime-stable" label; my variant was uploaded to "runtime-canary". Initiating a targeted redeploy of runtime canary subset to ensure runtime:3.5.1-prefetch-off applied.

lee: standing by. Router unchanged.

deploybot: applying runtime redeploy to canary subset now.

deploybot: runtime redeploy completed at 01:27 UTC. Post-redeploy health: runtime pods report the correct tag and prefetch=false. Re-evaluating p99.

ops-bot: post-redeploy metrics: p99 token latency dropped to 680ms, error_rate stable at 0.06%. No infra anomalies.

ryan: good. Resume canary ramp? Propose move to 20% for 25m then reassess. Any objections?

maya: no objections. Also filing a follow-up: ensure deploybot pool selectors validate image tag/variant mapping before ramp.

lee: go ahead. I'll keep ROUTER_REWRITE=false until console confirms support.

deploybot: ramping to 20% at 01:34 UTC. Monitoring.

ops-bot: at 01:50 UTC checks: p95/p99 within baseline, no increase in 5xx. Canary proceeding.

ryan: follow-ups: 1) add deploybot image-tag->pool assertion, 2) add a preflight check that validates feature flags (ROUTER_REWRITE) across router and console integration, 3) schedule extended staging for kv-prefetch behavior. I'll capture these in release notes. Great job catching the mis-target quickly.

maya: filing the deploybot assertion PR now.

lee: will coordinate console team to confirm header support before final rollout.

ryan: closing this window for now, will update release doc and set next slot if all good.
